calibrate_w_sparse_colmap: calibrate camera intrinsics and extrinsics from a COLMAP sparse reconstruction and dense depth directory
calibrate_frame_w_sparse_points: calibrate a single frame scale factor using sparse 3D points, intrinsics, extrinsics, and inverse depth
vote_scale: compute a robust scale estimate by averaging values within the 10th to 90th percentile range
store_visible_points_per_image: build a mapping from image IDs to their visible 3D points from a COLMAP reconstruction
review_calibrate_w_sparse_colmap: review the calibrate_w_sparse_colmap function that computes calibrated intrinsics, extrinsics, and scales from COLMAP data
